Message:
feat(Mountain): Bridge WebSocket frames to MountainIPCInvoke dispatch

Register a default handler on the Mist handler registry that bridges every
inbound `{ method, params }` WebSocket frame into the
`crate::IPC::WindServiceHandlers::mountain_ipc_invoke` dispatch path — the
same Tauri command used by the Sky frontend — so the full
WindServiceHandlers surface is reachable over the Mist WebSocket transport
without per-method registration.

The handler normalises params into a Vec<Value> (Array passes through,
Null becomes empty, scalars wrap into single-element) and delegates to the
existing mountain_ipc_invoke. The Mist secret is wrapped in Some() for
consistent optional semantics on ServeLocal.

This eliminates the staged handler-registration plan described in the
previous comment: the fallback makes every method available immediately.
